cohort: 66,586 deliveries from a database of 228,438 pregnancy and labor characteristics from 12 medical centers in the United States
finding: A machine-learning-based labor risk score, incorporating cervical dilation and other clinical parameters, can predict the risk of unfavorable labor outcomes.
mod_finding: The study developed a machine-learning-based labor risk score to predict cesarean delivery in active labor, among other adverse outcomes.
